AUDIT of #22079 head 09df3fd (code read, not run on alpaca): on a non-Bybit account ml_entry would REFUSE every decision (safe: no wrong trade, but it never trades). Hard-coded items: (1) src/runtime/ml_decision_features.py:76,83-84 the BTCUSDT anchor literal (btc_ret24 / btc_vol24 features, and the row is unformable without it). (2) src/runtime/strategy_signal_builders.py _ml_entry_reference_frames: the 60 crypto reference symbols come from the artifact (meta.xs_reference) and are fetched with the TRADED symbol's exchange client, keeping only frames whose last bar ts equals the decision bar. An Alpaca client cannot list the perps, and equity bars never share the crypto bar ts, so n_reference=0 < min_reference_symbols 40 -> refuse. The module cache _ML_ENTRY_REF_CACHE is keyed on bar time only, not venue (two venues would share frames). Needed: a per-account reference source (venue + universe) independent of the trading venue. (3) src/units/strategies/ml_entry.py:50 is_decision_bar is UTC hour % 4 on 24/7 bars; market hours are not modelled (equity 1h bars, session open/close). The generic market_closes_before_max_hold refusal (strategy_signal_builders ~6294) already exists for the 24h time stop. (4) No allowed-sides parameter: ml_entry does not call the existing _resolve_side_filter (side_filter / long_only), and nothing is per account. (5) Cost basis: tau and pred net R were fit net of the CRYPTO cost stack (fee 11 + slip 3 bps rt + funding 1 bps/8h); there is no per-account cost basis. (6) Features assume 24 bars/day (ret_168, vol168, hour/dow). Equity 1h series differ in distribution: an EVIDENCE question, not code. A roster add on alpaca_live needs its own Stage-0 record (roster-promotion-evidence-guard C1-C5) on the equity population. DONE WHEN: one ml_entry implementation takes per-account (or per-leg-per-account) reference source, anchor, sides, session/cadence and cost basis from config, with tests; plus an evidence record for the first non-crypto account.
